prompt:
Use case: photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 蜂; subject ID bee only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych with exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white seams about 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Top photograph: one honeybee perched naturally on the center of a meadow flower, three-quarter macro view. Show its fuzzy thorax, striped abdomen, antennae, translucent wings and anatomically plausible six legs, with the complete insect visible.
Middle photograph: one honeybee flying naturally in the air against softly blurred green meadow vegetation. Capture a clear suspended side or three-quarter view, legs beneath the body and translucent wings in flight, with the complete honeybee and wings within the frame; no flower or leaf touching it.
Bottom photograph: one honeybee resting side-on on a green leaf, its feet touching the leaf, clearly showing the side profile, antennae, fuzzy thorax, striped abdomen and folded translucent wings.
Composition/framing: three standalone wide landscape macro photographs in the specified order, one clearly recognizable honeybee centered per panel, with at least 12 percent crop-safe space around the complete insect, antennae and wings. Naturally blurred backgrounds, distinct flower, airborne and leaf contexts. Each panel must work independently after cropping.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic macro nature photography, real fine hairs, delicate wing veins and natural flower and leaf textures; gentle daylight, believable shadows, realistic colors and anatomy rather than glossy toy-like perfection.
Constraints: observe insects naturally without approaching people, feeding, bait, handling or anthropomorphism; no humans, gloves, hive equipment or clothing. Exactly three panels and two white seams. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, cartoon, illustration, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. Top: honeybee standing on a white flower with yellow center. Middle: honeybee suspended in flight against blurred meadow. Bottom: side-view honeybee standing on a green leaf. All insects, visible antennae and wings fit within their panels; lower legs overlap their natural supports. Fuzzy bodies, translucent wings and natural plant textures are visible, but exact leg counts and fine anatomy cannot be confirmed at preview resolution. No visible humans, handling, writing or watermark. Sharp measured white seam rows 598–604 and 1185–1191 in the 1024x1792 original; cuts 601 and 1188. Panel heights are slightly unequal.
